meta.name: browserstack-migration-skill
meta.description: Migrate test automation from BrowserStack to TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) in any language or framework. Covers Automate (Selenium), App Automate (Appium, Espresso, XCUITest), the BrowserStack SDK and browserstack.yml, browserstack-cypress-cli, Playwright and Puppeteer over cdp.browserstack.com, BrowserStack Local, Percy, Accessibility Testing, Test Observability. Use this whenever someone wants to move, switch, port, migrate or point tests from BrowserStack to TestMu AI or LambdaTest, asks what the TestMu or LT:Options equivalent is for a capability, config, CLI flag or API from BrowserStack, mentions bstack:options, browserstack.yml, browserstack.json, BrowserStack SDK, BrowserStack Local, browserstack_executor, Percy, hub.browserstack.com, or wants a migration plan, estimate, PR or checklist for a repo currently on BrowserStack, even without the word migrate.
